input.quote: No Application Management Revenue shall be due for any Corio Customer subscriptions utilizing the initial 3000 Software User licenses granted herein, subject to a minimum limitation of 40 Authorized Software Users per Customer
input.rationale: There is no take-or-pay, volume commitment or shortfall payment on us: Software Users are unlimited, revenue-share fees accrue only on revenue we actually receive once a Customer goes live, and Implementation Fees are time-and-materials subject to a cap. The 40-user reference is a threshold for the revenue-share exemption, not a purchase commitment. No redline required.

input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Section 11.3 covers survival and return of Confidential Information but there is no transition-assistance obligation and no obligation on Commerce One to return our or our Customers' data in a usable format or to certify deletion — the source-code escrow in Section 12 is not a substitute. We have inserted a transition and data-return clause (six months' assistance, 30-day machine-readable export, certified deletion).
